verdict.rationale: Yubico documents generating SSH keys directly on the YubiKey's FIDO2 application with OpenSSH. The private key never leaves the hardware, and FIDO2 requires user presence (a touch) for cryptographic operations. Hardware-backed private keys are also documented for PIV (via PKCS#11) and OpenPGP, and community reports corroborate ed25519 FIDO SSH keys, PIV and GPG smartcard use. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of SSH-specific touch policies for the PIV and OpenPGP paths.

support.subject: As a developer, my SSH keys can be hardware-backed on the device — via FIDO2 sk-ssh keys, PIV, or OpenPGP — so server access requires a physical touch
